campaign_intent: After every predecessor is structurally validated and frozen as a candidate, implement the first local single-writer vertical as one bounded construction campaign sharing one semantic kernel and one generated protocol model across desktop, CLI, and authorized remote clients. Owner approval is required only for the exact pre-merge candidate.
one_shot_interpretation: One frozen-input construction campaign with internal fail-fast stages; not one giant commit, one process, one deployment, or permission to skip gates and validation.

selected: desktop, CLI, and authorized remote client surfaces
candidates_not_selected: SQLite as the embedded transactional store
Unix domain sockets on Unix and named pipes on Windows for local IPC
versioned HTTPS plus streaming for remote clients
a WASI-compatible WebAssembly component host for extensions
Playwright or Chrome DevTools Protocol as the supervised browser driver

runtime_units.responsibility: Validate commands and apply deterministic lifecycle transitions; the only accepted-state semantic authority.
Coordinate identity, expected revision, idempotency, policy, persistence, proposals, effects, and receipts.
Store workspaces, artifacts, revisions, events, proposals, grants, receipts, snapshots, migrations, and recovery markers transactionally.
Expose one versioned command/query/event contract independent of local IPC, HTTP, CLI, or desktop presentation.
Provide scriptable commands and structured output through the same protocol semantics as every other client.
Provide the focused writing UI as a thin client with no independent lifecycle or authority rules.
Authenticate remote actors, enforce scoped grants and rate/resource bounds, and translate without changing semantics.
Run proposal-producing agent operations behind explicit capabilities, budgets, cancellation, and evidence capture.
Optionally isolate portable extensions behind a versioned capability ABI; no ambient filesystem, process, secret, or network authority.
Turn authorized browser action envelopes into supervised sessions, evidence, and explicit certain, failed, or uncertain outcomes.
Bind commands, revisions, proposals, effects, tests, traces, redaction, and runtime receipts without becoming product authority.

phases.completion_gate: Every selected business and capability input is current, structurally validated, and frozen by digest. Owner approval is not required until an exact merge candidate exists.
Each package validates independently with closed sources, IDs, relations, views, residue, and zero authority effect.

requires: DomainSpec v2 source and compiler identity
phases.completion_gate: Two clean runs yield byte-identical graph and system ontology; missing or changed selected dependencies are blocking.
All units compile and their unit, integration, migration, crash-recovery, protocol-parity, isolation, and negative-effect tests pass against exact bytes.
Every business rule has exact realization and test/observation evidence or remains an explicit gap; no system success promotes business meaning.

requires: all exact D65 identities and digests
produces: ConstructionBinding candidate and exact pre-merge approval envelope
phases.completion_gate: Before merge, the Essays Project owner decides the exact frozen merge candidate, its conformance reliance, next-use suitability, and claim ceiling. Release and deployment remain separate decisions.

preimplementation_decisions: Bind a durable owner decision to the exact Product Capability digest.
Select and freeze capability input/output contracts, context policy, obligations, and realization preconditions.
Select the embedded store and define transaction, migration, backup, corruption, and recovery semantics.
Select single-process versus supervised service topology and lifecycle ownership.
Select local IPC framing, discovery, permissions, version negotiation, and Windows parity.
Select remote protocol, authentication, authorization, streaming, reconnect, replay, and rate/resource limits.
Select the desktop host and its update, origin, content-security, and native-capability boundary.
Select whether WebAssembly is required in the first vertical and freeze its ABI, host capabilities, budgets, and portability target.
Select the browser driver and exact approval, credential, download/upload, navigation, uncertain-effect, and evidence rules.
Select supported platforms and measurable latency, startup, durability, and resource budgets.
failure_policy: Fail closed at the first missing selected dependency, digest drift, non-deterministic generation, migration failure, semantic parity failure, isolation escape, ambiguous external effect, or evidence-binding failure. Preserve receipts and residue; do not execute successor phases implicitly.
